facts.note: At the bell's nine strike Aurèle had each guest bring out a watch. Vauthier states his own watch was two minutes ahead of the bell. The inspection is described as Aurèle making each of them produce their watch and remarking on it, which matches 'inspected our watches'.
Piquet in the salon until a quarter to eleven by Vauthier's watch. He then went out to the hall for his cigar case from his coat. Madame began the piano as he left and stopped when he returned.
The hall clock struck eleven 'a moment after I sat down again', stated as the sequence after his return to his seat.

added.quote: I sat down, and Madame took up her cards.
added.why: Madame had stopped the piano when Vauthier came back and, after he sat down, she was back at the card table. This places her in the salon with cards at a moment before the eleven strike that the sheet does not cover, and gives the order that she resumed cards after he sat down.
